Marta Kowalski
Senior Backend Engineer — Java / Spring / Distributed Systems
marta.kowalski.dev@example.com | Warsaw, Poland (remote-friendly)

SUMMARY
Backend engineer with 10 years of experience building and operating high-throughput Java
services. Led the migration of a monolithic order-processing system to event-driven
microservices at ShipFast. Comfortable owning services end-to-end: design, implementation,
on-call, and cost.

EXPERIENCE

Senior Software Engineer — ShipFast Logistics (2019 – Present, 6 years)
- Led the decomposition of a 400k-line Spring MVC monolith into 14 Spring Boot
  microservices over 18 months, using the strangler fig pattern to migrate traffic
  incrementally without a big-bang cutover.
- Designed the event backbone on Apache Kafka: 3 clusters (6 brokers each), ~40 topics,
  exactly-once semantics for the payment-settlement pipeline using Kafka transactions and
  idempotent producers. Personally wrote the settlement consumer group's rebalance and
  dead-letter-queue handling after we hit duplicate charges in production during a
  broker failover in month 4.
- Own the PostgreSQL data layer for the orders service (partitioned by shipment date,
  ~180M rows, RDS Multi-AZ). Introduced read replicas and a Redis cache in front of the
  hot "shipment status" query path, cutting p99 latency from 800ms to 90ms.
- Improved system performance and reliability across the platform.
- Migrated CI/CD from Jenkins to GitHub Actions and containerized all services with Docker,
  deployed on Kubernetes (EKS). Wrote the Helm charts and the HPA policies for the three
  highest-traffic services.
- On-call lead for the payments pillar; wrote the postmortem for a Kafka consumer-lag
  incident that traced back to an unbounded retry loop on a poison-pill message — added a
  DLQ and a circuit breaker (Resilience4j) as the fix.
- Worked closely with the platform team on observability: instrumented services with
  Micrometer, Prometheus, and Grafana; built the on-call dashboard for consumer lag,
  broker under-replicated partitions, and p95/p99 latency per endpoint.
- We worked with AWS across the board — EC2, RDS, S3, SQS, EKS, CloudWatch.

Software Engineer — FinEdge (2016 – 2019, 3 years)
- Built REST APIs in Spring Boot for a small-business lending platform, backed by
  PostgreSQL and Hibernate/JPA.
- Wrote integration tests with Testcontainers against real PostgreSQL and Kafka instances;
  pushed the team from ~30% to ~75% meaningful test coverage (measured via JaCoCo, focused
  on branch coverage of the underwriting rules engine, not line coverage vanity metrics).
- Implemented the underwriting rules engine's audit trail using event sourcing (custom,
  not Axon) — every decision replayable from the append-only log.
- Collaborated with the security team on a PCI-DSS scope reduction project — worked with
  AWS.

Junior Developer — FinEdge (2015 – 2016, 1 year)
- Maintained a legacy Struts application, fixed bugs, wrote unit tests with JUnit and
  Mockito.

EDUCATION
